title: Streaming and push updates cannot be represented as a single OIX v0.1 envelope
purpose: Document a negative/partial mapping case for A2A streaming and push updates against OIX v0.1's discrete message model.

expected.description: A bridge may emit discrete OIX messages to represent selected stream updates only under a documented extension/profile. It must preserve sequence/correlation and clearly signal omitted stream guarantees. A single task.progress or task.result message cannot be claimed to reproduce A2A stream ordering, reconnect, subscription, or incremental artifact semantics. If no bridge profile exists, report streaming as unsupported.

limitations: Illustrative event list; not serialized A2A wire data.
No live streaming or push endpoint tested.
Ordering, reconnect, delivery guarantees and duplicate handling are not specified.
